positive_snippets: The hotel is situated at a very prime and very easy to reach location, parking outside of the hotel is available. Rooms are good. There's no dining room or restaurants in the hotel but room service is available. What so ever food you order will be delivered in your room. Staff is very courtious, owner Mr Vashisht is very nice and polite. Food is tasty and delicious. Rates are a little bit higher. But overall it's nice place to stay.
We went there for a party and the food was so tasty 😋. Staff was very co operative.
The hotel is economical, they have medium sized rooms and staff is polite.
negative_snippets:
Good hotel for day or two, very economical with all the facilities like tv, mini fridge, locker, AC etc.

There is no lift but staff is very helpful. Also there is no refund policy once booked (via mmt) also if you wish to stay extra 1-2 hours , you have to pay full day amount.

Location is very good, for new traveler, 'sapna talkies' is a nearby landmark.
Very bad experience.. Room are dampy and smelly. Towels are very black and  torn.  Pillows are very horrible.  Worst experience
